Class OncePerRequestFilter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.filter.GenericFilterBean
org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Filter, Aware, BeanNameAware, DisposableBean, InitializingBean, EnvironmentAware, EnvironmentCapable, ServletContextAware
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractRequestLoggingFilter, CharacterEncodingFilter, CorsFilter, FormContentFilter, ForwardedHeaderFilter, HiddenHttpMethodFilter, MultipartFilter, OpenEntityManagerInViewFilter, RelativeRedirectFilter, RequestContextFilter, ServerHttpObservationFilter, ShallowEtagHeaderFilter, UrlHandlerFilter
public abstract class OncePerRequestFilter extends GenericFilterBean
Filter base class that aims to guarantee a single execution per request dispatch, on any servlet container. It provides a doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, FilterChain) method with HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse arguments.

过滤器可以作为在独立线程中发生的REQUEST或ASYNC分派的一部分被调用。可以在web.xml中配置过滤器，以决定是否应将其纳入异步分派。然而，在某些情况下，Servlet 容器会采用不同的默认配置。因此，子类可以重写shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch()方法，静态声明是否确实应在两种类型的分派中各被调用一次（即仅调用一次），以便提供线程初始化、日志记录、安全等功能。此机制是对在web.xml中使用分派器类型配置过滤器的补充，而非替代。

子类可以使用 isAsyncDispatch(HttpServletRequest) 来确定过滤器何时作为异步分发的一部分被调用，并使用 isAsyncStarted(HttpServletRequest) 来确定请求何时已置于异步模式，因此当前分发不会是给定请求的最后一次分发。

另一种也会在其自身线程中发生的分发类型是ERROR。如果子类希望静态声明在错误分发期间是否应被调用一次，可以重写shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch()。

`getAlreadyFilteredAttributeName()` 方法用于确定如何识别请求是否已过滤。默认实现基于具体过滤器实例的配置名称。

Since:
06.12.2003

    • shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch

      protected boolean shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch()
      The dispatcher type jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType.ASYNC means a filter can be invoked in more than one thread over the course of a single request. Some filters only need to filter the initial thread (for example, request wrapping) while others may need to be invoked at least once in each additional thread for example for setting up thread locals or to perform final processing at the very end.

      注意，尽管可以通过 `web.xml` 将过滤器映射到处理特定分发器类型，或通过 Java 中的 ServletContext 进行配置，但 servlet 容器可能会针对分发器类型强制执行不同的默认设置。此标志强制实施过滤器的设计意图。

      默认返回值为"true"，这意味着在随后的异步分发中不会调用该过滤器。如果为"false"，则会在异步分发中调用该过滤器，并保证在单个线程的请求中仅被调用一次。

      Since:
      3.2

    • doFilterInternal

      protected abstract void doFilterInternal(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, jakarta.servlet.FilterChain filterChain) throws jakarta.servlet.ServletException, IOException
      Same contract as for doFilter, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread. See shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch() for details.

      提供 HttpServletRequest 和 HttpServletResponse 参数，而不是默认的 ServletRequest 和 ServletResponse。

      Throws:
      jakarta.servlet.ServletException
      IOException

    • doFilterNestedErrorDispatch

      protected void doFilterNestedErrorDispatch(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, jakarta.servlet.FilterChain filterChain) throws jakarta.servlet.ServletException, IOException
      Typically an ERROR dispatch happens after the REQUEST dispatch completes, and the filter chain starts anew. On some servers however the ERROR dispatch may be nested within the REQUEST dispatch, for example, as a result of calling sendError on the response. In that case we are still in the filter chain, on the same thread, but the request and response have been switched to the original, unwrapped ones.

      子类可以使用此方法过滤此类嵌套的 ERROR 分发，并在请求或响应上重新应用包装。`ThreadLocal`上下文（如果有）仍然应该处于活动状态，因为我们仍处于过滤器链的嵌套中。

      Throws:
      jakarta.servlet.ServletException
      IOException
      Since:
      5.1.9
